title: Trofie Pasta with Velvety Italian Sauce
description: A classic Italian pasta dish featuring trofie pasta tossed in a rich and creamy sauce.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil.
Cook the trofie pasta according to the package instructions until al dente.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the heavy cream and bring to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and stir in the parmesan cheese until melted.
Drain the cooked pasta and add it to the skillet with the sauce.
Toss the pasta in the sauce until well coated.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
